summary: Frontend-only verification of the /solutions editorial redesign (Phase 2) + Phase 1 regression sweep. ALL requested items PASS. The /solutions route now renders the new editorial design (Geist + Inter + IBM Plex Mono, bb-* utility classes, #f1f2fa hero with 64px grid overlay, asymmetric hero split, #e8eaf3/#f1f2fa/#eceefa alternating sections, dark #0a1230 final CTA). All 15 required headings preserved verbatim, Customization Stack table has correct 3 headers + 5 rows in correct order, all 3 deployment vertical tabs swap content correctly, all 5 CTAs point to the correct routes, and anchor navigation (#model-customization, #value-realization, #deployment) scrolls to the right sections. No regressions on Home, About, Contact, Careers, or Header nav. No cream #fffdf7 remnants anywhere in the DOM.
critical_code_review_comments: SolutionsNew.jsx is a clean, self-contained rewrite (~400 lines) with all content constants (customizationCards, stackRows, valueCards, deploymentTabs) hoisted to module scope — good separation, easy to maintain.
All CTAs use Link with data-testid; deployment tabs use setState + activeDeploymentTab which correctly renders the matching heading/body — no bugs found.
Anchor scroll uses a 120px offset via getBoundingClientRect + smooth behavior — works reliably (measured top=~120 for all three anchors).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 /solutions redesign VERIFIED end-to-end. Do NOT re-test /solutions unless SolutionsNew.jsx changes. Key data-testids on /solutions: solutions-page, hero-talk-cta, customize-model-cta, request-assessment-cta, deployment-talk-cta, research-explore-cta, customization-card-{0-2}, value-card-{0-2}, stack-row-{0-4}, deployment-tab-{deployment|serving|infrastructure}, deployment-content-{deployment|serving|infrastructure}. Global bg #f1f2fa is applied via <html> (rgb 241,242,250); body picks up rgb(232,234,243)=#e8eaf3 from section overlap — this is intentional per design (alternating light shades) and is NOT a cream regression. Home pipeline SVG (previous iteration bug fix) still renders correctly — no overlap between corner brackets and axis labels.
